body.statement: Using the second-order staircase alignment handle, derive a primitive block-ratio expression \(\Delta_n^{\dagger}(K;\eta_n)\) and constants \(0<c<C<\infty\), common across \(n\), such that \[c\Delta_n^{\dagger}(K;\eta_n)\le\Delta_n^*(K;\eta_n)\le C\Delta_n^{\dagger}(K;\eta_n)\] for every vanishing tail sequence \(\eta_n\), where \(\Delta_n^*\) is optimized over the explicitly defined slice \(\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{CY},0}\) of \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}\). Establish the coverage frontier in this finite-slice experiment: \(\Delta_n^{\dagger}(K;\eta_n)\sqrt{\log(2K)}\to0\) must imply \(\sup_{P_n\in\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{CY},0}}\Gamma_n(P_n)\to0\); conversely, for every primitive candidate \(\beta\) with \(\beta\triangleleft\Delta^{\dagger}\) and \(\beta_n(K)\sqrt{\log(2K)}\to0\) along a subsequence on which \(\Delta_n^{\dagger}(K;\eta_n)\sqrt{\log(2K)}\) is bounded away from zero, construct one complete staggered low-rank triangular array \((P_n)_{n\ge1}\in\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}\) satisfying \(P_n\in\mathcal M_n^{\mathrm{CY},0}\), \(\delta_n(P_n;\eta_n)\ge c\Delta_n^{\dagger}(K;\eta_n)\), and \(\liminf_n\Gamma_n(P_n)>0\). The derivation must first test whether the balanced strong-factor rank-one second-order remainder is \(o(\Delta_{\mathrm{CY},n}(K))\); if so, \(\Delta^{\dagger}\) must use the smaller attained scale.
body.justification: The honest open content is necessity: published norm bounds can be sufficient yet unattainable by any legal low-rank staircase panel.
body.gap: Chernozhukov--Chetverikov--Koike give nearly sharp generic vector-sum arrays, but those arrays need not arise from the Choi--Yuan debiasing map; no source establishes an attainable panel-specific converse.
body.consumer: A resolved frontier tells empirical researchers exactly how far the event horizon may grow without ad hoc band inflation and prevents overclaiming a coarse perturbation bound as sharp.
